title: Lossy slab: optical absorption, Joule heating and energy balance (analytic)
description:
A 1.55 um plane-wave mode in a y-periodic glass strip (n0 = 1.5) crosses a slab with sigma_e = 2e3 S/m; em_heat_joule hands the absorbed power to heat, which leaves only through the substrate (out_of_plane_convection, insulated x faces), and heat_em_thermo_optic feeds T back (a silica-like dndT: negligible shift).
Analytic: absorbed fraction A = (1 - R) (1 - exp(-a d)) = 86.6 % (a = 2 k0 kappa the power attenuation, kappa = Im sqrt(eps), R the front-face reflection); temperature from the 1D k theta'' - H theta = -q0 exp(-a (x - x0)) inside the slab (Green function exp(-p |x - s|) / (2 k p), p = sqrt(H / k), H = h sides / thickness).
Derived values tab: P_absorbed, P_up, P_down against the Fresnel / Beer-Lambert closed forms (a few 1e-4; P_down = P_in (1 - R)^2 (1 + kappa^2 / n^2) exp(-a d), the exit factor |N|^2 / n^2 of a wave leaving an absorbing medium, 1.7e-3 here), and the energy balance P_loss = integral of H (T - T0) = P_absorbed and dT_mean = P_absorbed / (H Lx Ly) (exact up to the A reference).
Line profile tab: T_profile against the 1D solution; the small ripple near the slab back is the standing wave of its weak reflection.
Field tab: em.ez_abs, em.absorbed_power and heat.T maps.

parameters.name: P_in
parameters.description: mode source power in W per m of z (2D)

parameters.name: lambda0
parameters.description: vacuum wavelength of the FDFD solve

parameters.name: k_vac
parameters.description: vacuum wavenumber k0 in 1/m

parameters.name: n0
parameters.description: glass index (eps_r = n0^2, also inside the slab)

parameters.name: sigma_slab
parameters.description: optical conductivity sigma_e of the slab in S/m (Im eps / eps_r = 0.083: weak loss)

parameters.name: x_slab0
parameters.description: slab front face (on a cell face)

parameters.name: d_slab
parameters.description: slab thickness along x

parameters.name: x_slab1
parameters.description: slab back face

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: strip length along x (CPML outside for EM, insulated x faces for heat)

parameters.name: Ly
parameters.description: period along y (periodic EM boundaries, insulated heat faces)

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size; the lines below sit at cell centres

parameters.name: x_src
parameters.description: mode source line (cell 50 centre), launching toward +x

parameters.name: x_flux_up
parameters.description: upstream flux monitor (cell 65 centre): net power into the slab

parameters.name: x_flux_down
parameters.description: downstream flux monitor (cell 335 centre): transmitted power

parameters.name: k_glass
parameters.description: thermal conductivity in W/(m K), everywhere

parameters.name: dndT_glass
parameters.description: thermo-optic coefficient in 1/K (silica-like: the few-K rise shifts A by < 1e-4)

parameters.name: T0
parameters.description: substrate (ambient) and reference temperature in K

parameters.name: t_film
parameters.description: film thickness the 2D model stands for (out-of-plane loss per volume ~ 1 / thickness)

parameters.name: h_sub
parameters.description: heat transfer coefficient to the substrate in W/(m^2 K): k of silica / 2 um buried oxide

parameters.name: n_sides
parameters.description: cooled film faces (out_of_plane_convection sides)

parameters.name: eps_imag
parameters.description: Im eps = sigma / (omega eps0) of the slab

parameters.name: eps_abs
parameters.description: |eps| of the slab

parameters.name: kappa
parameters.description: extinction coefficient Im sqrt(eps) of the slab

parameters.name: n_re
parameters.description: Re sqrt(eps) of the slab

parameters.name: ksi0
parameters.description: half-cell phase n0 k0 dx / 2 (grid-dispersion factor below)

parameters.name: a_att
parameters.description: power attenuation coefficient of the discrete wave in 1/m (a d ~ 2.01)

parameters.name: R_front
parameters.description: power reflection of the slab front face (~4.2e-4)

parameters.name: exit_factor
parameters.description: back-face power transmission over (1 - R) for a wave leaving an absorbing medium: |N|^2 / n_re^2 (1 + 1.7e-3)

parameters.name: A_ref
parameters.description: absorbed fraction (back-face reflection and interference neglected, ~1e-4)

parameters.name: P_abs_ref
parameters.description: analytic absorbed power in W/m

parameters.name: H_loss
parameters.description: volumetric loss coefficient H in W/(m^3 K)

parameters.name: dT_mean_ref
parameters.description: analytic mean rise over the window in K (energy balance)

parameters.name: p_heat
parameters.description: inverse heat spreading length sqrt(H / k) in 1/m (0.42 um)

parameters.name: q_front
parameters.description: absorbed power density at the slab front in W/m^3

parameters.name: c_heat
parameters.description: Green-function prefactor q0 / (2 k p) of T_profile in K/m

analytic_curves.name: T_profile
analytic_curves.expression: T0 + c_heat*where(x < x_slab0, exp(-p_heat*(x_slab0 - x))*(1 - exp(-(a_att + p_heat)*d_slab))/(a_att + p_heat), where(x < x_slab1, (exp(-a_att*(x - x_slab0)) - exp(-p_heat*(x - x_slab0)))/(p_heat - a_att) + (exp(-a_att*(x - x_slab0)) - exp(-a_att*d_slab)*exp(-p_heat*(x_slab1 - x)))/(p_heat + a_att), exp(-p_heat*(x - x_slab1))*(exp(-a_att*d_slab) - exp(-p_heat*d_slab))/(p_heat - a_att)))
